verdict.rationale: Linear exposes a public GraphQL API and SDK that can be used to programmatically read out all workspace data (issues, projects, docs) in an open format, and it supports importing from other services, but there is no documented one-click 'export all my data and leave' feature or bulk-export tool in the evidence pack. missing for 10: a dedicated data-export/backup feature, documentation confirming full data (attachments, history, comments) can be extracted, and any migration-out tooling akin to the import tooling.
